rule: Applied narrowly to B9-B11 natural owners. Stable Block/KP ids and exam-relevant traditional LM/IF/EM tables were preserved. The repair separates clinical syndrome, morphology pattern, immune pattern and etiologic disease without replacing the 306 pathology syllabus with a modern nephrology taxonomy.

repairs.target: urinary-b09 pathology-coordinate entry / traditional pathology comparison
applied: Clinical syndrome and LM/IF/EM damage pattern are separate coordinates; neither pattern alone equals final etiology.
Traditional 306 pathology labels remain as exam recognition indices.
Mesangial proliferative, MPGN and FSGS are explicitly pattern-first and require etiologic context.
Subendothelial/endocapillary injury is retained as an inflammatory/nephritic tendency and subepithelial/podocyte injury as a heavy-proteinuria tendency.
Deposit location is not encoded as a deterministic syndrome or etiology lookup.
RPGN III identity is pauci-immune crescentic GN: IF sparse/negative and no typical dense deposits.
ANCA association remains high-yield but ANCA positivity is not required by the pauci-immune definition.
The 306 I anti-GBM/linear, II immune-complex/granular, III pauci-immune/often-ANCA triad is preserved.
IF mesangial IgA dominance/co-dominance is the stable identity anchor.
Mesangial proliferation remains the high-yield common LM pattern but LM is explicitly variable; EM mesangial/paramesangial deposits are retained.
IgA is no longer encoded as identical to one fixed mesangial-proliferative LM entity.
B10 inherits the accepted B7 Current RAS-blockade owner.
Old absolute Scr/BP/protein targets remain Source-specific exam Precision rather than a second Current clinical truth.
The traditional five-type table remains a 306 morphology index rather than five same-level single-cause entities.
MsPGN is a mesangial-proliferative LM pattern, MPGN is a double-contour pattern, and FSGS is a focal-segmental sclerosis injury pattern; each may have multiple etiologic backgrounds.
MCD/membranous classic identities are preserved while secondary etiologies remain possible.
Traditional steroid/cyclophosphamide pairings remain 306 Source Precision.
MCD typical steroid responsiveness is preserved; traditional primary FSGS lower responsiveness remains an exam tendency.
An FSGS/MsPGN/MPGN morphology alone no longer owns immunosuppression; treatment follows the specific disease/etiology owner.
The classical size/charge model remains available for 306 recognition.
Current MCD mechanism inherits B2 podocyte/slit-diaphragm functional injury and foot-process effacement rather than creating a second pure-charge molecular owner.

preserve_without_rewrite: PSGN post-infectious timing, endocapillary proliferation and subepithelial hump recognition
anti-GBM linear IF identity and pulmonary-renal interface
RPGN crescent as a severity/rapid-progression morphology rather than a standalone cause
MCD near-normal LM with foot-process effacement and typical steroid responsiveness
membranous nephropathy subepithelial immune deposits/spike recognition and thrombosis interface
traditional 306 age/LM/IF/EM comparison tables as exam-recognition Precision
after_apply: B9-B11 are PASS_BLOCK_LEVEL_K for the audited scope. Whole-A3 K remains blocked by B5 until its separate acid-base Source/owner decision is resolved.
